macros.name: skipenzh
macros.doc: Skip between a Chinese character and a Western character or a math formula.

macros.name: skipzhlineendclose
macros.doc: Skip after a fullwidth closing punctuation when it occurs at the end of a line.

macros.name: skipzhlineendfullstop
macros.doc: Skip after a fullwidth fullstop punctuation when it occurs at the end of a line.

macros.name: skipzhlineendhalfstop
macros.doc: Skip after a fullwidth halfstop punctuation when it occurs at the end of a line.

macros.name: skipzhlinestartopen
macros.doc: Skip before a fullwidth opening punctuation when it occurs at the start of a line.
